pairs: de sacerdotibus qui fuerunt in Anathoth, in terra Benjamin.
the son of Hilkiah of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin.
Quod factum est verbum Domini ad eum in diebus Josiæ filii Amon,
The word of the Lord, which came to him in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon,
in the thirteenth year of his reign,
Et factum est in diebus Joakim filii Josiæ,
and which came to him in the days of Jehoiakim,
usque ad consummationem undecimi anni Sedeciæ,
even until the completion of the eleventh year of Zedekiah,
even until the transmigration of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
Et factum est verbum Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
“Before I formed you in the womb,
And before you went forth from the womb,
et prophetam in gentibus dedi te.
And I made you a prophet to the nations.”
ecce nescio loqui, quia puer ego sum.
I do not know how to speak, for I am a boy.”
And the Lord said to me:
quoniam ad omnia quæ mittam te ibis,
For you shall go forth to everyone to whom I will send you.
et universa quæcumque mandavero tibi loqueris.
And you shall speak all that I will command you.
You should not be afraid before their face.
quia tecum ego sum ut eruam te,
For I am with you, so that I may deliver you,”
And the Lord put forth his hand,
And the Lord said to me: “Behold,
Ecce dedi verba mea in ore tuo:
I have placed my words in your mouth.
ecce constitui te hodie super gentes et super regna,
today I have appointed you over nations and over kingdoms,
so that you may root up,
and so that you may build and plant.”
Et factum est verbum Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
And the Lord said to me:
quia vigilabo ego super verbo meo,
For I will keep watch over my word,
so that I may accomplish it.”
Et factum est verbum Domini secundo ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me a second time,
“I see a cooking pot upon a fire,
et faciem ejus a facie aquilonis.
and its face is before the face of the north.”
And the Lord said to me:
Ab aquilone pandetur malum super omnes habitatores terræ:
“From the north, an evil will spread over all the inhabitants of the earth.
quia ecce ego convocabo omnes cognationes regnorum aquilonis,
For behold, I will call together all the close associates of the kingdoms of the north,
et ponent unusquisque solium suum in introitu portarum Jerusalem,
and each one of them will place his throne at the entrance to the gates of Jerusalem,
et super omnes muros ejus in circuitu,
and over all its surrounding walls,
and over all the cities of Judah.
et loquar judicia mea cum eis super omnem malitiam eorum qui dereliquerunt me,
And I will speak my judgments with them, concerning all the wickedness of those who have forsaken me,
and who have offered libations to strange gods,
and who have adored the work of their own hands.
et loquere ad eos omnia quæ ego præcipio tibi.
and speak to them everything that I instruct you.
You should not have dread before their face.
nec enim timere te faciam vultum eorum.
For I will cause you to be unafraid of their countenance.
Ego quippe dedi te hodie in civitatem munitam,
For certainly, this day, I have made you like a fortified city,
and an iron pillar, and a brass wall,
and to the people of the land.
And they will make war against you,
so that I may free you.”
